threads.subject: Photo Required in Work & Study Permit Applications -- REP-2019-0767
threads.question:
Subject: Photo Required in Work & Study Permit Applications Dear ImmRep, Are applicants required to upload a scanned copy of a photo or a digital photo with work, study or visitor visa applications? The instructions are unclear as they seem to suggest that if the applicant is required to provide biometrics they do not have to provide photos, but photos are still required in the document checklist.
1. Proof of identity
0A valid passport or travel document that guarantees you re-entry to the country or territory that issued it and 0Two (2) photos of yourself and accompanying family members that meet the Visa application photograph specifications.
Note: if you need to give biometric information (biometric fingerprints and a biometric photo), do not include paper photos. Find out if you need to
give biometrics.
[https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/application/application-forms-guides/guide-5487-applying-work-permit-outside-canada.html](https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/application/application-forms-guides/guide-5487-applying-work-permit-outside-canada.html)
Thank you,
Ruscito, Giovanni (IRCC/IRCC)
threads.answer:
Immigration Representatives / Représentants immigration # Good Day,
Correct, if the applicant is required to submit biometrics, they are exempt from providing paper photos. If the applicant is not required to submit biometrics, then they have to submit two photos. The same requirements apply to both paper and e-applications. If you have any further enquiries, you may contact us at .
Regards,
The Immigration Representatives Mailbox
